execution_envelope_correction.projection: Gate-time elapsed already includes both completed profiles; add only projected fit/prediction work plus a separate 300-second worker projection margin.
execution_envelope_correction.provider_scope: The 6,000-second kernel-process deadline starts at bootstrap entry. Kaggle queue/cold-start before process entry and provider output transport after process exit are outside the watchdog; no hard provider-from-push bound is claimed.
execution_envelope_correction.regression_case: Runtime spec computed at t=200 with deadline 6000 has 5200 seconds; runner launch at t=700 resolves to 5000 seconds.
execution_envelope_correction.runner_watchdog_resolution: Immediately before each worker Popen, runner computes min(existing spec timeout, 5200 seconds, kernel deadline - current monotonic time - 300 seconds). The resolved limit is persisted in spec.json, timeout_resolution.json, heartbeat and terminal/failure receipt.
execution_envelope_correction.worker_runtime_limit: min(5200, kernel deadline minus actual worker start minus 300 seconds); the same reduced limit is applied to the recipe worker and runner watchdog.

predecessor.reason: V5 recomputes the runner watchdog at actual worker launch after runner preflight; it preserves V4 timing projection, kernel deadline, finalization reserve, scientific factors and membership.
